pages.title: Solve complex problems overnight
pages.description: Hand a long job to a small or local model before you log off, with each step getting only the files it needs.

pages.description: Give every step only the context it needs, reuse proven code and run each decision on the smallest model that does it well.

pages.description: Every run leaves a record of what worked and what failed, and Baltor is designed to set up the next task with it.

pages.description: For a developer whose coding agent starts every task from nothing: give each step the guidance and reusable code it needs.
